items.title: 3 Low-Volatility Stocks That Concern Us
items.summary: Low-volatility stocks may offer stability, but that often comes at the cost of slower growth and the upside potential of more dynamic companies.

items.title: Gen Digital CEO addresses GoDaddy acquisition rumors
items.summary: Investing.com -- Gen Digital Inc. (NASDAQ:GEN) shares rose 5% in after-hours trading Monday after CEO Vincent Pilette addressed recent acquisition speculation and highlighted the company’s recently raised fiscal 2027 outlook.

items.title: GoDaddy Stock: Is GDDY Underperforming the Technology Sector?
items.summary: GoDaddy has lagged behind the technology sector over the past year, and analysts remain somewhat optimistic about the stock’s outlook.

items.title: GoDaddy Jumps on Takeover Report While the Would-Be Buyer’s Stock Sinks
items.summary: When a takeover report sends the would-be buyer's stock tumbling far harder than the target's rises, the market is saying something worth listening to about who really benefits from this deal.

items.title: Wix (WIX) Stock Trades Down, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of website building platform Wix (NASDAQ:WIX) fell 5.1% in the afternoon session after Gen Digital made a takeover approach for GoDaddy, a peer web services provider, putting pressure on stocks in the sector.

items.title: Is GoDaddy (GDDY) A Takeover Target After An Early Acquisition Offer?
items.summary: GoDaddy (NYSE:GDDY) has received an early acquisition proposal from Gen Digital for a potential takeover of the web services provider. The approach from Gen Digital targets GoDaddy’s domain registration and online security tools as a way to expand its software footprint. Details on pricing, deal structure, and timeline have not been publicly disclosed, leaving the terms of any potential transaction unclear.
